scripts.build: npm run bootstrap && lerna run --sort build && copy-dist
scripts.copy-dist: mkdir dist && cp projects/libraries/scxml/dist/scxml*.js dist/ && cp projects/devtools/debug/dist/scxml.debug.js dist/ && cp projects/libraries/core/dist/scion.* dist/ && cp projects/libraries/schviz/dist/schviz.* dist/
scripts.commit: lerna exec --concurrency 1 'if [ "$( git status --porcelain )" ]; then pwd; git diff | less; git commit -a; fi;'
scripts.commit-packages: lerna exec --concurrency 1 'if [ "$( git status --porcelain )" ]; then pwd; git commit -a -m "Update package version"; fi;'
